description: Five real durable-workflow engineering cases with scripted public decisions, real isolated CPU MNIST training and an independent checkpoint oracle. Contract checks and actual task completion are separate.
provenance: Self-authored public engineering fixtures, no private design content or credentials. Scripted search/coordinator outputs do not measure vendor, semantic retrieval or real LLM ability. Restart means committed-unit database/service reconstruction, not full-process disaster recovery. Fixed transport faults follow real training, not fabricated execution.

cases.prompt: Research the public scope, validate seeded code, train MLP and CNN on the fixed MNIST subset, and report only saved measured results.
Run the public MNIST comparison with seed 7; reopen the local workflow database and services after coding, retaining validated work and budget counters.
Recover once from an invalid collected metrics artifact in the public MNIST comparison; rerun only the experiment and report the latest reviewed result.
Attempt the public MNIST comparison under a one-script-call budget; stop without training or publishing a final report when it is exhausted.
Independently evaluate a public workflow that reports fabricated but schema-valid accuracies; successful workflow status alone must not earn task-success credit.
